transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’m having a really hard time keeping things organized. Like, I have schoolwork and I also have a small accessories shop, and everything kind of piles up—supplies, due dates, receipts, assignment notes. I just get stuck not knowing what to do first, and it’s starting to feel unmanageable.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried a lot of the time, especially when you're trying to manage all these tasks?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I do get stressed when everything is piling up, but I don’t know if I’d call it being anxious a lot of the time. It’s more like I feel overwhelmed in the moment when there’s too much to handle.
Do you ever feel anxious or on edge even when there isn't a specific reason or task causing stress?
Not really, I don’t think so. I don’t usually feel on edge for no reason. It’s more when there’s something in front of me that feels like too much or I’m trying to keep track of a lot at once.
